question.prompt: The third exit on a highway is located at milepost \(40\) and the tenth exit is at milepost \(160.\) There is a service center on the highway located three-fourths of the way from the third exit to the tenth exit. At what milepost would you expect to find this service center?

solutions.explanation:
The fraction describes the distance between the two exits, so first find that distance:
\[
160-40=120\text{ miles}.
\]
Three-fourths of this distance is
\[
\frac34\cdot120=90\text{ miles}.
\]
Starting at milepost \(40\) and traveling \(90\) miles toward milepost \(160\) puts the service center at \(40+90=130\). The answer is milepost \(130\), choice \(\text{E}\).
solutions.title: Find three-fourths of the distance
